summary: This standards-track document extends TRILL to support multi-topology routing of unicast and multi-destination traffic, using the IS-IS multi-topology mechanism of RFC 5120. It lets a TRILL network carry traffic over separate topologies.

eli5.summary: A city can have a bus map and a bike map. This lets one network keep several different maps and send each kind of traffic by the right one.

questions: how does trill support multiple topologies
